name: CIS Microsoft SQL Server 2019 / 2022 Benchmark
description: CIS Microsoft SQL Server 2019 / 2022 Benchmark checks, with backup, integrity and ownership checks of our own. Needs agent 1.18.0+ and read access of NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM to each instance; an instance the agent cannot connect to is Manual.

checks.name: Ad Hoc Distributed Queries is disabled
checks.description: OPENROWSET and OPENDATASOURCE let users query remote data sources ad hoc.
checks.remediation: EXECUTE sp_configure 'show advanced options', 1; RECONFIGURE; EXECUTE sp_configure 'Ad Hoc Distributed Queries', 0; RECONFIGURE; EXECUTE sp_configure 'show advanced options', 0; RECONFIGURE;

checks.name: clr enabled is disabled
checks.description: CLR assemblies run .NET code inside SQL Server.
checks.remediation: EXECUTE sp_configure 'show advanced options', 1; RECONFIGURE; EXECUTE sp_configure 'clr enabled', 0; RECONFIGURE; EXECUTE sp_configure 'show advanced options', 0; RECONFIGURE;

checks.name: cross db ownership chaining is disabled
checks.description: Ownership chains across databases let a user reach objects of another database without permissions on them.
checks.remediation: EXECUTE sp_configure 'show advanced options', 1; RECONFIGURE; EXECUTE sp_configure 'cross db ownership chaining', 0; RECONFIGURE; EXECUTE sp_configure 'show advanced options', 0; RECONFIGURE;

checks.name: Database Mail XPs is disabled
checks.description: Database Mail can send data out of the server.
checks.remediation: EXECUTE sp_configure 'show advanced options', 1; RECONFIGURE; EXECUTE sp_configure 'Database Mail XPs', 0; RECONFIGURE; EXECUTE sp_configure 'show advanced options', 0; RECONFIGURE;

checks.name: Ole Automation Procedures is disabled
checks.description: OLE Automation procedures run COM objects with the rights of the SQL Server service.
checks.remediation: EXECUTE sp_configure 'show advanced options', 1; RECONFIGURE; EXECUTE sp_configure 'Ole Automation Procedures', 0; RECONFIGURE; EXECUTE sp_configure 'show advanced options', 0; RECONFIGURE;

checks.name: remote access is disabled
checks.description: Remote access lets stored procedures run on this server from remote servers.
checks.remediation: EXECUTE sp_configure 'show advanced options', 1; RECONFIGURE; EXECUTE sp_configure 'remote access', 0; RECONFIGURE; EXECUTE sp_configure 'show advanced options', 0; RECONFIGURE;

checks.name: remote admin connections is disabled
checks.description: The dedicated admin connection should only be reachable locally (except on failover cluster instances).
checks.remediation: EXECUTE sp_configure 'show advanced options', 1; RECONFIGURE; EXECUTE sp_configure 'remote admin connections', 0; RECONFIGURE; EXECUTE sp_configure 'show advanced options', 0; RECONFIGURE;

checks.name: scan for startup procs is disabled
checks.description: Procedures that run at startup are a place for persistence.
checks.remediation: EXECUTE sp_configure 'show advanced options', 1; RECONFIGURE; EXECUTE sp_configure 'scan for startup procs', 0; RECONFIGURE; EXECUTE sp_configure 'show advanced options', 0; RECONFIGURE;

checks.name: TRUSTWORTHY is off on user databases
checks.description: A TRUSTWORTHY database lets its code act with server-level rights (msdb is exempt).
checks.remediation: ALTER DATABASE [<database>] SET TRUSTWORTHY OFF;

checks.name: The sa login is disabled
checks.description: The login with SID 0x01 is the best-known target of password guessing.
checks.remediation: ALTER LOGIN [<sa login>] DISABLE;

checks.name: The sa login is renamed
checks.description: A renamed sa login is harder to guess.
checks.message: {Instance}: the login with SID 0x01 is still named sa
checks.remediation: ALTER LOGIN [sa] WITH NAME = [<new name>];

checks.name: xp_cmdshell is disabled
checks.description: xp_cmdshell runs operating system commands with the rights of the SQL Server service.
checks.remediation: EXECUTE sp_configure 'show advanced options', 1; RECONFIGURE; EXECUTE sp_configure 'xp_cmdshell', 0; RECONFIGURE; EXECUTE sp_configure 'show advanced options', 0; RECONFIGURE;

checks.name: Windows authentication only
checks.description: Mixed mode allows SQL logins with passwords kept by SQL Server.
checks.remediation: Server properties > Security > Windows Authentication mode, then restart the service.

checks.name: At most 3 sysadmin logins
checks.description: Enabled sysadmin logins other than service accounts (NT SERVICE\*, ##...##, NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM).
checks.remediation: ALTER SERVER ROLE sysadmin DROP MEMBER [<login>]; grant only the permissions needed.

checks.name: SQL logins enforce the password policy and expiration
checks.description: Enabled SQL logins without CHECK_POLICY or CHECK_EXPIRATION.
checks.message: {Instance}: no password policy or expiration for {WeakPolicyLogins}
checks.remediation: ALTER LOGIN [<login>] WITH CHECK_POLICY = ON, CHECK_EXPIRATION = ON;

checks.name: Every user database has a full backup from the last 24 hours
checks.description: Online user databases, from the backup history in msdb.
checks.message: {Instance}: no full backup in 24 hours for {NoFullBackupDatabases}
checks.remediation: Schedule a daily full backup (BACKUP DATABASE) of every user database.

checks.name: Databases in full recovery have a log backup from the last hour
checks.description: FULL and BULK_LOGGED user databases need log backups to meet the recovery point objective (and to keep the log from growing).
checks.message: {Instance}: no log backup in an hour for {NoLogBackupDatabases}
checks.remediation: Schedule log backups (BACKUP LOG) at least hourly, or use the SIMPLE recovery model where point-in-time restore is not needed.

checks.name: Every user database had a good CHECKDB in the last 7 days
checks.description: From the last known good DBCC CHECKDB; manual before SQL Server 2016 SP2, where it cannot be read.
checks.message: {Instance}: no good CHECKDB in 7 days for {NoCheckDbDatabases}
checks.remediation: Schedule DBCC CHECKDB weekly (for example with a maintenance plan).

checks.name: No linked server signs in as sa
checks.description: A linked server mapped to sa gives its users sysadmin on the remote server.
checks.message: {Instance}: linked servers sign in as sa: {LinkedServersSa}
checks.remediation: EXEC sp_droplinkedsrvlogin, then map to a least-privilege login with sp_addlinkedsrvlogin.

checks.name: No user database is owned by sa
checks.description: Databases owned by sa make ownership chains and TRUSTWORTHY escalate to sysadmin.
checks.remediation: ALTER AUTHORIZATION ON DATABASE::[<database>] TO [<dedicated owner login>];

checks.name: Connections are encrypted or the databases use TDE
checks.description: Warns when Force Encryption is off (and not every connection is encrypted) and a user database is without TDE.
checks.message: {Instance}: Force Encryption is off and without TDE: {NoTdeDatabases}
checks.remediation: Turn on Force Encryption with a trusted certificate (SQL Server Configuration Manager), or encrypt the databases with TDE.

checks.name: At least 12 error log files are kept
checks.description: Enough error logs to investigate after several restarts.
checks.remediation: EXEC xp_instance_regwrite N'HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE', N'Software\Microsoft\MSSQLServer\MSSQLServer', N'NumErrorLogs', REG_DWORD, 12;

checks.name: Failed logins are audited
checks.description: Login auditing set to failed logins or both; manual when the registry cannot be read.
checks.remediation: Server properties > Security > Login auditing: Failed logins only (or Both), then restart the service.
